newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel premiums drift as screen plunges.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel premiums drift as screen plunges.

text.p: NWE jet fuel marked time on Monday as plunging IPE gas oil futures values scared physical traders to the sidelines, with premiums notionally unchanged.
"The prices are a little wild to do something," one trader said.

Benchmark Dec IPE futures plunged $8.50 to $215.50 a tonne on news that the United Nations Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali had approved the startup of Iraqi oil sales under an oil-for-food deal.
Traders said premiums were hard to assess in the absence of trade but barges were notionally unchanged at Dec IPE +$24 fob ARA. Cargo premiums were notionally Dec IPE +$36 cif NWE.
